ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: accusative masculine indefinite (form II) verbal noun
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَفْسِيرًا is in the derivative form: تَفْسير
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ف/س/ر   f–s–r to explain, to interpret, to explicate, to elucidate. Of this root, تَفْسير tafsır occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَفْسير tafsır [v. n. of v. II] explanation, interpretation, elucidation

(25:33)‏ ‏جِئْنَاكَ‏ ‏بِالْحَقِّ‏ ‏وَأَحْسَنَ‏ ‏تَفْسِيرًا‏ يَأْتُونَكَ‏ ‏بِمَثَلٍ‏ ‏إِلاَّ‏‏ وَلاَ they never offer an argument to you without Our bringing you the truth and a better explanation.
